title: The mechanical and oxidation properties of novel B2-ordered Ti2ZrHf0.5VNb0.5Alx refractory high-entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting under a Ti-gettered argon atmosphere on a water-cooled copper crucible. Raw metals of Ti, Zr, V, Nb, Al with purity of 99.95 wt% and Hf with purity of 99.5 wt% were used. The ingots were flipped and remelted at least seven times to assure chemical homogeneity.
